content.text:
The artifact check passes with EXIT=0: the compiled olean is usable, the main statements hold from the artifact, and axioms are the permitted three.

Now cleanup: delete probe files `_S1852Probe1.lean`, `_S1852Probe2.lean`, and logs `_s1852.log`, `_s1852_build.log`, `_s1852_check.log`. Keep `_S1852ArtifactCheck.lean`? It's a useful independent check; but it's in tmp with `_` prefix like other probes. I'll keep it (it's small evidence) — hmm, the project has many `_`-prefixed probes; keeping is consistent. Actually to minimize clutter, I'll keep the artifact check (it documents the artifact verification) and delete the two broken/duplicate probes and logs.

Careful with delete verification: verify absolute paths are inside D:\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper and root logs.

Then:
1. Recompute SHA of source (unchanged since last build) and olean.
2. Check the source hash is the same as the built olean's source (yes, no edits after rebuild... wait, after the rebuild I created the check file only; the S1852 source hasn't changed since the last rebuild ✓ (SRC_SHA=0FD8E48..., SRC_BYTES=30764)).
3. Send the message to the parent.

Also consider: should I update coord/STATE.md and AUDIT_LEDGER.md? The user's instruction to me: write the Lean file, report SHA/EXIT/olean. AGENTS.md (workspace) asks each packet to update node/STATE/queue and AUDIT_LEDGER. As a subagent sharing the workspace, editing shared coord files risks conflicts with the parent, and the parent is coordinating. I'll report the finding and note that STATE/AUDIT updates are left to the parent (and provide the text). Actually, hmm — the instructions say "本包结束更新节点、STATE 与 queue". Since the parent orchestrates, I'll mention it in my message but not edit to avoid clobbering.

Actually, adding an entry to AUDIT_LEDGER.md is low-risk if appended at the end... but two concurrent agents appending could conflict. I'll leave it to the parent and provide concise text in the message.

Let me clean up and compute final hashes.

content.name: run_code
content.arguments:
{"code": "
const res = await tools.pwsh({ description: "Clean scratch files and compute final evidence", command: [
"$paths = @('D:\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\_S1852Probe1.lean','D:\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\_S1852Probe2.lean')",
"foreach ($p in $paths) { if (Test-Path $p) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $p -Force; Write-Host \"removed $p\" } else { Write-Host \"absent $p\" } }",
"foreach ($p in @('D:\\lean\\_s1852.log','D:\\lean\\_s1852_build.log','D:\\lean\\_s1852_check.log')) { if (Test-Path $p) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $p -Force; Write-Host \"removed $p\" } }",
"$src = Get-Item 'D:\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1852CoherentCoverActual.lean'",
"$ol = Get-Item 'D:\\lean\\.lake\\build\\lib\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1852CoherentCoverActual.olean'",
"Write-Host \"SRC  bytes=$($src.Length) sha256=$((Get-FileHash $src.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)\"",
"Write-Host \"OLEAN bytes=$($ol.Length) sha256=$((Get-FileHash $ol.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)\"",
"Write-Host \"olean newer than source: $($ol.LastWriteTime -ge $src.LastWriteTime)\"",
"Get-ChildItem 'D:\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper' -Filter '*S1852*' | Select-Object Name,Length"
].join("; "), timeoutMs: 600000 });
console.log(res.kind==="foreground" ? res.stdout.text + res.stderr.text : JSON.stringify(res));
", "description": "Clean up and compute final hashes"}
